name: Mangatan
subtitle: Read, look up, and mine.
description: The official sideloading source for Mangatan, a Mangayomi fork focused on dictionary lookup, OCR, subtitle mining, and Anki export.

apps.name: Mangatan
apps.subtitle: Read, look up, and mine
apps.localizedDescription: Mangatan is a Mangayomi fork focused on Yomitan-style dictionary lookup, OCR overlays, subtitle mining, and Anki export.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's changed

• Added [Chimahon•compatible immersion statistics](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/65), including novel and manga reading tracking, Anki mining stats, reader statistics sheets, backup, and sync support.
• Added Yomitan kanji dictionary imports and Yomitan•style kanji lookup by selecting a kanji inside a word popup.
• Fixed dictionary WebView refresh after theme, language, and dictionary changes.
• Fixed marking multiple selected manga or novel chapters as unread.
• Fixed bookmarks so they follow the chapter currently being read instead of the chapter originally opened.
• Added the novel reader Text Size control to reader settings.
• Added AVIF page support and preserved OCR loading progress when changing pages.
• Improved iOS sideload and Mihon bridge compatibility, and added Linux release packaging.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9
